title: Document control software for Canadian quality and operations teams
description: Evaluate document control software through revision, approval, retrieval and migration workflows, with practical tests for Canadian quality teams.
author: ISO Certification Consultants Editorial Team

sources.title: Guidance on the requirements for documented information of ISO 9001:2015
supportedClaims: This is edition-specific historical guidance for ISO 9001:2015, not proof of the current edition.
Documentation should support operational processes and provide evidence.
The guidance allows different forms of documented information and does not require every organization to use identical documents.

sources.title: ISO 9001 explained
supportedClaims: Certification is performed by independent certification bodies; ISO does not certify organizations.
Software alone does not establish that a quality management system conforms to a standard.
